reviews_data.review_text: Took my morning walk over to the brand new Maman storefront. If you love stunning, polished spaces, intentional local discovery, and treated-yourself French pastries, you will genuinely love stepping inside here. The coffee is fantastic and pastries are to die for (gluten-free raspberry oat bar is a must try!). Will definitely be downloading the app and coming back again soon!
